integrity: The proof is an algebraic consequence of the published triangular multiplication and the published identification of the inessential quotient with the radical; no computational or external certification claim is made.
scientific_limitations: Classifies only closed two-sided ideals containing the compact operators for the Liu--Shen triangular realization; no assertion is made about ideals strictly below the compacts or about unrelated Calkin realizations.
title: The complete closed-ideal lattice above the compacts for triangular Calkin realizations
